segments.text: This is The Hour Brief. Everything that mattered today, in AI and tech, business and the markets, in one sitting.
Each story is a card. Swipe through the day, one clear idea at a time, with the takeaway that matters.
Save a story for later, or share it, in a single tap.
Prefer to scroll? Switch to List, and read the whole edition top to bottom.
Short on time? Open Audio, and listen to today's brief, read aloud.
Voices brings you the week's sharpest thinking, from the people worth listening to, across tech, business, product and finance.
Then test yourself with the daily Challenge, and keep your streak going.
Make it yours. Pick your sections, set the text size, and get a gentle morning reminder.
The Hour Brief. Free on iPhone and Android. Built for one sitting.
